annotations.title: Check AI provider outages (What Broke Today)

description: Current status, per-component status where the feed has it, and incidents from the last 7 days for 20 AI and developer providers (OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, xAI (Grok), Mistral AI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Replit, Vercel v0, Lovable, Bolt.new, Hugging Face, Perplexity, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Supabase, Windsurf, GitHub, Groq, npm), taken only from their official status feeds by Agent Tested's What Broke Today. Aliases work too, e.g. chatgpt, claude, claude-code (the Claude Code component on Anthropic's status page), grok. Omit provider to get only providers that are not fully operational. Feeds can lag; quote the check time.

provider.description: Provider id or common name, e.g. openai, chatgpt, claude, claude-code, grok, github, groq, cursor
